items.title: A web film makes no request outside the loopback server
items.detail: The web engine fails every request that is not to the local server, so a film's source cannot fetch anything while it renders.

items.title: No path can leave the film folder
items.detail: Thesium resolves every workspace path and refuses the ones that point outside the film folder.

items.title: The studio serves only finished media
items.detail: It binds to 127.0.0.1 and mounts only out, review and assets.

items.title: No secret in the code or its history
items.detail: A gitleaks scan of the tree and the git history finds nothing.

items.title: Narration models come from the person, not the film
items.detail: Kokoro downloads once. Thesium checks the file against a pinned size and SHA-256 before it uses it.
